name: Apache CouchDB 3.5
description: Single-node CouchDB with Fauxton, Obsidian LiveSync CORS and backups.

upstream.couchdb: couchdb:3.5.3 (Apache CouchDB 3.5.3, Debian trixie; digest sha256:0ba6b4b8dd823232185fa2c7de04634b925be62f97c9b7cbece7dd9119470e17, built 2026-11-24)

COUCHDB_USER.description: Server admin created at boot (Fauxton login, LiveSync username).

COUCHDB_PASSWORD.description: Server admin password, generated at deploy and re-applied at every boot. Under 12 characters locks the admin (see the deploy log).

COUCHDB_SECRET.description: Secret that signs session cookies. Keep it stable or every session ends.

COUCHDB_ERLANG_COOKIE.description: Erlang distribution cookie (single node; needed only if you later cluster).

NODENAME.description: Erlang node name suffix (couchdb@127.0.0.1). Do not change after the first boot: shard maps use it.

COUCHDB_CORS_ORIGINS.description: Origins allowed by CORS with credentials, comma-separated. The default lets Obsidian desktop and mobile (Self-hosted LiveSync) connect; empty = CORS off.

COUCHDB_REQUIRE_VALID_USER.description: true = every request except GET /_up needs a login (recommended on a public domain).

COUCHDB_MAX_DOCUMENT_SIZE.description: Largest document in bytes (LiveSync recommends 50 MB).

COUCHDB_MAX_HTTP_REQUEST_SIZE.description: Largest HTTP request in bytes (bulk uploads, replication).

PORT.description: CouchDB HTTP port: public HTTPS domain, healthcheck (/_up) and Fauxton (/_utils).

COUCHDB_URL.description: Admin URL over the private network for other services (PouchDB, nano, replication).

COUCHDB_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public HTTPS URL (LiveSync URI, Fauxton at /_utils, replication from devices).

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time CouchDB gets to finish writes and shut down on redeploy.

COUCHDB_USER.description: Admin account used for backups (kept in sync by reference).

BACKUP_S3_BUCKET.description: Railway Bucket that stores the backups.

BACKUP_S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE.description: Keep false: Railway Buckets use virtual-hosted-style URLs.

BACKUP_PREFIX.description: Folder in the bucket; each run writes {prefix}/{UTC timestamp}/.

BACKUP_DATABASES.description: Databases to back up, comma-separated. Empty = every database (plus _users).

BACKUP_INCLUDE_USERS.description: Also back up the _users database (CouchDB user accounts with password hashes).

BACKUP_ATTACHMENTS.description: true = include attachments (couchbackup marks this experimental; LiveSync does not use attachments).

BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Delete complete runs older than this many days.

BACKUP_KEEP_MIN.description: Always keep at least this many complete runs, whatever their age.

BACKUP_WAIT_SECONDS.description: How long a run waits for CouchDB before failing.

RESTORE_RUN.description: Restore only (start command /usr/local/bin/couchdb-backup restore): run folder, or latest.

RESTORE_TARGET.description: Restore only: NEW database to restore into. Empty = {database}_restored; existing databases are never touched.
